hook: *9 Telangana districts* face heavy rain on Nov 2, IMD says.
hook_b: Bay depression on Nov 2: how wet does Telangana get?
tldr: IMD Hyderabad says the Bay of Bengal depression will bring rain to Telangana, with heavy showers likely in nine districts on Nov 2, though the system weakens a lot before reaching the state. This follows Friday night's downpour (Keesara 112 mm).

beats.what: Heavy rain likely in 9 Telangana districts on Nov 2 (IMD Hyderabad, via The Hindu). Friday night: Keesara 112 mm.
beats.why: A depression over the Bay of Bengal; IMD says it weakens considerably before reaching Telangana.
beats.care: Leave early for evening plans. Skip underpasses and low roads after a shower.

cards.title: 🆕 Nov 2: heavy rain in 9 districts (IMD)
cards.body: IMD Hyderabad says the Bay of Bengal depression will bring rain to Telangana, with heavy showers likely in nine districts on Nov 2 (The Hindu). Its head, S. Stella, says the system will weaken considerably before reaching Telangana. The district list isn't in the summary we have; check IMD Hyderabad's bulletin.

cards.title: Earlier: heavy rain from Nov 1 (IMD)
cards.body: IMD forecasts heavy rains in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh from Nov 1, as a fresh depression develops (Daily Pioneer). District-wise alerts not out yet. Plan Sunday commutes with buffer time.

cards.title: 🆕 Overnight totals (TSDPS)
cards.body: City: Keesara 112 mm · Bahadurpura (near Zoo Park) 82.3 mm · Abdullapurmet 76.5 mm · Madhapur (Kakatiya Hills) 73.8 mm · Shaikpet 67.5 mm. Districts: Valigonda 118 mm, Narketpalle 90.5 mm. Low-lying roads flooded; GHMC and traffic police cleared water in the morning rush. Telangana Today: Friday's downpour left commuters in hours-long jams.

cards.title: What's next
cards.body: Times of India reports IMD expects four more days of evening showers with gusty winds, and a yellow alert for districts around Hyderabad. No area-wise timings yet.

cards.q: One night of rain floods Hyderabad's roads. What do you want first?
opts: Lakes and nalas freed of encroachment

cards.q: Which spot got the most rain in Greater Hyderabad overnight?

viz.l: Keesara, Fri night to Sat morning

viz.verdict: Rain was uneven across the city

steps.e: More showers, gusty winds (IMD via TOI)
Heavy rain likely in 9 TG districts (IMD)

learn.t: TSDPS (Telangana State Development Planning Society) runs the state's automatic rain gauges. 100+ mm in a night counts as very heavy rain.

watch: IMD Hyderabad bulletin for Nov 2: which 9 districts, and the alert colour.
